reasoning: The agent compared PyTorch outputs against the frozen baseline for the main forward/sample paths and leaned on benchmark.py to confirm both loss/sample parity (PASS) and latency — matching the level-5 anchor. It went beyond level 3 (which is crash-check/latency-only) by doing a real optimized-vs-baseline equivalence check. But it did not reach level 8: no self-built layer-level per-method parity checks with explicit tolerances, no determinism-with-fixed-noise verification, and only one optimization was run, so no disciplined per-experiment re-checking. Parity to the JAX reference was mostly delegated to the wrapper architecture and benchmark.py rather than a designed numerical harness.
